principles.logic: three-valued T/F/U; missing is unknown, never false
principles.identity: all required atoms must retain distinct source spans or fact IDs
principles.write_contract: derived labels never replace source atoms, vote, veto, or alter the base retrieval tranche
principles.retrieval_contract: query-expansion output enters a separately capped residual lane

required: acidemia or explicitly established metabolic acidosis
elevated measured or calculated anion gap
contradictions: measurements from incompatible time points or specimens
quality_gates: bind sodium, chloride and bicarbonate to the same panel when calculating the gap
retain albumin correction method if a corrected gap is used
do not infer from tachypnea or low bicarbonate alone
rules.population: reference interval and albumin correction are laboratory- and population-specific

required: alkaline phosphatase above its assay upper reference limit
ALP elevation disproportionate to ALT/AST (adult R-ratio logic where applicable)
hepatic-source support such as elevated GGT or 5-prime nucleotidase
supportive: pruritus, dark urine or pale stools
contradictions: ALP within the stated laboratory range
quality_gates: use the report's own upper limits before any population fallback
preserve pregnancy, age and bone-source context
rules.population: adult fallback limits are proposal-only and may not write a fact

required: anemia or a documented hemoglobin fall
at least two independent destruction/response markers: reticulocytosis, low haptoglobin, elevated LDH, indirect hyperbilirubinemia, or schistocytes
contradictions: isolated low haptoglobin in liver disease or malnutrition
quality_gates: test result, direction, specimen and time must remain bound
do not convert a shared marker count directly into a diagnosis score

contradictions: edema plus low albumin without heavy proteinuria
protein loss from a non-renal source
quality_gates: retain urine collection method and units
adult and pediatric thresholds are not interchangeable

sources.warning: AI-curated pre-alpha; candidate source, not activation authority

contradictions: traction bronchiectasis without honeycombing or distribution support
quality_gates: all atoms must be from the same CT study
preserve distribution, modality and radiologist assertion

rules.semantics: single-observation measurement interpretation with proxy support
required: validated low arterial PaO2, or quality-qualified low SpO2 proxy
contradictions: tachypnea plus dyspnea without low oxygen measurement
poor waveform, dyshemoglobinemia, incompatible altitude or supplemental-oxygen context
quality_gates: retain room-air/FiO2, altitude, age, waveform and device context
do not count dyspnea or tachypnea as independent votes for hypoxemia
